onsemi NFVA35065L32 e-compressor IPM: onsemi reference price USD 27.6 (maker's page).

notes: No production board facts (layers, size, laminate) found for any of the seven boards; all board facts are from reference designs or ORNL/Infineon documents, as labelled. Placements: no source states a component count for any board.

Production chip identity found only for Tesla Model 3 (TI C2000 + ST STGAP1AS, from open-source reverse engineering, not a formal teardown) and the 2017 Prius PCU (ORNL, tentative). VW MEB APP310, Hyundai Ioniq 5, BYD (MCU) and the 5th-gen Prius PCU were searched without a named IC; Munro / Yole board BOMs are paywalled.
The task's TIDA-010075 was not found in any source; TIDM-02014 is used instead. PGA411-Q1 does not appear in TIDM-02014 (it uses the C2000 / AM263P with resolver or the LDC5072-Q1 option).

TIDM-02014 BOM changed between revisions: 2023 lists TMS320F280039C-Q1, UCC14240-Q1, UCC12051-Q1, AM2634-Q1; rev A (May 2025) lists UCC5881-Q1, F29H859TU-Q1, TPS653860-Q1, AMC0386-Q1, AMC0381D-Q1, LM5158-Q1, LM74202-Q1.
EBOOST: no teardown or production controller IC found (Valeo SQ7, BorgWarner eBooster searched); key-IC rows are supplier application pages.
Valeo's SQ7 supercharger uses a switched-reluctance motor; BorgWarner's eBooster a BLDC with SmCo magnets - the controller topology therefore differs by supplier.
